overview.description: The NEOS Real Estate High Income ETF (IYRI) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in real estate equity. The fund is an actively managed fund that seeks high monthly income with the potential for appreciation by actively investing in stocks of the Dow Jones U.S. Real Estate Capped Index while also utilizing call options strategies. IYRI was launched on Jan 14, 2025 and is issued by Neos.
